job_description:
Core4ce is recruiting a Software Engineer to serve as a seasoned technical contributor and emerging leader on complex software development programs supporting the U.S. Government. In this role, you will leverage advanced knowledge across engineering, computer science, and information technology to design, develop, and implement sophisticated software solutions tailored to unique government requirements.

You will provide direction to junior engineers, exercise independent technical judgment, and have the opportunity to interface directly with government clients - all while contributing to programs with tangible mission impact. You will work on-site at the National Air and Space Intelligence Center (NASIC) - one of the nation's premier intelligence production centers - located at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Dayton, Ohio. NASIC sits at the forefront of air, space, and cyberspace intelligence analysis, and your contributions will directly inform decisions at the highest levels of the U.S. defense and intelligence enterprise.

Responsibilities

Provide technical direction and mentorship to junior and entry-level software engineers, supporting team growth and code quality.

Apply advanced knowledge across Engineering, Computer Science, and/or Information Technology to technically design, develop, and implement complex software programs and systems.

Exercise initiative and independent judgment on complex assignments requiring creative problem-solving and sound engineering decision-making.

Develop software solutions uniquely tailored to meet specific Government requirements and operational needs.

Function as Project Leader when required, including direct interfacing with Government clients and stakeholders to define requirements, report progress, and deliver results.

Prepare and generate high-quality technical reports, documentation, and other program artifacts pertinent to the position and contract requirements.

Requirements

Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Technology is required.

One of the following combinations qualifies:

Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Technology plus 10+ years of relevant experience Associate's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Technology plus 14+ years of relevant experience Active Top Secret/SCI Highly Desired Expertise: Candidates who bring one or more of the following capabilities will be highly competitive:

Designing, developing, and deploying Cloud-native applications in complex, mission-critical environments Implementing and managing Event-Driven Architectures (EDA) at enterprise scale Building secure software solutions grounded in industry security best practices and frameworks Practical experience and demonstrated proficiency in software development using the Scrum framework Design and implementation of modern, intuitive User Interfaces (UI) Advanced Certified ScrumMaster (A-CSM) or equivalent advanced Scrum certification Relevant Scrum developer certifications (e.g., CSD, ASD) with demonstrated skills and hands-on experience Kubernetes certifications (CKA - Certified Kubernetes Administrator; CKAD - Certified Kubernetes Application Developer) Why Work for Us? Core4ce is a team of innovators, self-starters, and critical thinkers-driven by a shared mission to strengthen national security and advance warfighting outcomes.

We offer

401(k) with 100% company match on the first 6% deferred, with immediate vesting Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage-employee portion paid 100% by Core4ce Unlimited access to training and certifications, with no pre-set cap on eligible professional development Tuition assistance for job-related degrees and courses Paid parental leave, PTO that grows with tenure, and generous holiday schedules Got a big idea? At Core4ce, The Forge gives every employee the chance to propose bold innovations and help bring them to life with internal backing. Join us to build a career that matters-supported by a company that invests in you.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability, veteran status, age, genetic information, or other legally protected status.
